newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks seen rising on back of Dow.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks seen rising on back of Dow.

text.p: Argentine stocks were expected to track Wall Street higher at the opening Thursday, dealers said.
"The market looks good and will be buoyed by today's U.S. payrolls report, which is very favorable," said Nestor De Cesar of traders Allaria Ledesma.
"The data is clearing the way for more gains on the international markets and the (blue-chip) MerVal index may aim for 850," he added.
The MerVal rose 0.7 percent Wednesday to 824.11. It had rebounded from a losing spell Tuesday gaining 1.1 percent.

"There is a sense of calm after the (U.S.) Federal Reserve meeting. It went as we expected and the icing on the cake is today's jobs report," another trader said. "Still, there's no euphoria -- this is a chance for the market to calmly resume its upward course."
The Fed decided Wednesday to keep short-term rates flat at 5.5 percent and traders said the new jobs data indicated it might not be tempted to touch them in August either.
